ev-workshops-in-southeast-asia-aftermark.core: Posted in last 7 days EV Workshops in Southeast Asia - Aftermarket Challenges China’s EV advantage is not only about vehicles. One part of China’s EV industry that is often overlooked is the aftermarket supply chain. China has built a large ecosystem around EVs, including: 🔋 Battery testing & diagnostics 🔧 EV diagnostic scanners ⚡ High-voltage safety & testing equipment 🔌 EV charging testing equipment 🛠️ Repair tools & workshop equipment 🔩 EV spare parts & components ♻️ Battery repair, reuse & recycling And this ecosystem is becoming increasingly relevant outside China. By the end of 2025, China had around 43.97 million NEVs on the road, including more than 30 million battery-electric vehicles. At the same time, China exported 2.615 million NEVs in 2025, more than double the previous year. This creates a second question: Who will service all these EVs after they leave China?
